easyPrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using The Sixth Doctor this turn.
description:
Cast Jace by paying {4}{U}{U}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Jace spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Jace spells.
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Jace token.
Activate a Jace token's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 4.
